top_signals.title: US-Iran Tensions High After Strikes on Two Tankers in Hormuz
top_signals.summary: US-Iran tensions over the Strait of Hormuz heightened after a flurry of military strikes at the start of the week, with neither side prepared to cede ground over the crucial waterway.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: £100 million competition to back British AI companies to fix public services
top_signals.summary: £100 million fund competition will help promising British AI start-ups start in the UK and tackle some of society's biggest challenges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Partners Group CEO Rejects Redemption Concerns
top_signals.summary: Partners Group CEO David Layton joined Bloomberg Open Interest to push back on concerns that his move to CIO signals trouble at the private-markets giant. He explains why the leadership shake-up isn’t tied to redemption pressure, says the firm is gaining fundraising share despite an industry slowdown, and reveals why elevated evergreen-fund redemptions could continue for another 12 to 18 months. (Source: Bloomberg)
